confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Laos tourist-town pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable; accommodation and cocktail/wine are less certain. Lao kip pricing is volatile and many venues quote in USD or THB, so values may drift. FX value was taken from RBA latest-rates results surfaced by search (16 Oct 2026, 0.6947), not from a directly fetched RBA table; verify before relying on it for exact conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: secondary Laos backpacker and riverside destinations (e.g., Luang Prabang) adjusted down for Vang Vieng's smaller scale, plus northern Thailand budget tourist towns for accommodation and drink levels.
